title: Dean Cornwell Painting to be Offered at Auction
content: Dean Cornwell's original oil painting for "The Fight at Minowa" will be sold at Heritage Auctions on November 1, 2019.If you haven't seen it yet, here's a glimpse of Cornwell working on that very painting. (Link to YouTube)The Fight at Minowawill be at Heritage Auction, November 1, along with a lot of American wildlife and western art, illustration, and landscape painting.
